title: "Switch to Next Activity" should open Activity Switcher
line: Holding the Switch to Next/Previous Activity shortcut now shows the activity switcher, listing activities in the order the shortcut goes through them.
explanation: The activity switcher sidebar is only shown by SwitcherBackend for its own "Walk through activities" shortcuts (Meta+A), which go through activities by most recent use. "Switch to Next/Previous Activity" are separate plasmashell actions that just ask kactivitymanagerd to switch in its fixed name order, so nothing was shown. The backend now also listens for those two global shortcuts (KGlobalAccel::globalShortcutActiveChanged) and shows the switcher while their modifier keys are held, exactly like Meta+A. While it is shown for them, the list is sorted the way kactivitymanagerd orders activities (case-insensitive name, then id), so the highlight moves down the list step by step; Meta+A keeps its recent-use order.

commits.message:
activitymanager: show the switcher for Switch to Next/Previous Activity

Unlike "Walk through activities", the Switch to Next and Previous
Activity shortcuts never showed the switcher. Now they show it while
their keys are held, listing activities in the fixed order they use.

BUG: 484584

media.caption: Master: holding Meta+Alt and pressing N (Switch to Next Activity) switches from Default to Games, but no switcher appears.
Patched, same steps: while Meta+Alt is held the switcher shows Default, Games, Work with Games highlighted as the new activity.
For comparison, master's Meta+A (Walk through activities) switcher, the one the reporter wants, which lists activities by recent use.
Patched: holding Meta+Alt and pressing N, N, P walks Games → Work → Default → Work; the list keeps the fixed name order and closes on release.
